title: Voulant honneur (Sandrin)
desc: Pierre Sandrin, Voulant honneur, 1545. 4 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Model_0012); edited by Marco Gurrieri, Vincent Besson, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
